A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same 41-page ChunkKV paper, including Appendices A–J. Pages 2–41 match in extracted text and rendered appearance; the first-page differences are limited to author annotation and the arXiv stamp.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark evaluations, KV-cache preservation analyses, and inference-efficiency experiments in Section 4 and Appendices A–B.

after.justification: v3 retains these original experimental results, including LongBench, NIAH, GSM8K, JailbreakV, and efficiency evaluations.

M1.justification: Section 3 and Algorithms 1–3 retain the same chunk scoring and selection, recent-window retention, and layer-wise index reuse procedures.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same LongBench English and Chinese tasks, NIAH retrieval, GSM8K and many-shot GSM8K reasoning, and JailbreakV scenarios.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged in corresponding experiments, including StreamingLLM, H2O, SnapKV, PyramidKV, and FullKV in the main comparisons and KIVI in Appendix B.6.

E3.justification: The reported model configurations, cache budgets, context lengths, prompt settings, sample sizes, and evaluation metrics remain unchanged throughout the main text and appendices.

E4.justification: The same chunk-size and index-reuse ablations, layer-similarity analyses, and KV-cache L1-loss and attention-similarity analyses remain in Section 4 and Appendices A–B.

E5.justification: Both versions report three experimental runs with mean scores in Section 4 and ten repetitions for latency and throughput measurements in Section 4.3. Statistical reporting is unchanged.

E6.justification: The numerical results and plotted findings are identical, including benchmark scores, efficiency measurements, and appendix analyses. No result entries are added, removed, or revised.

T1.justification: Appendix C retains the same definitions, Conditions 1–2, Lemma 1, Theorem 1, and proof. The efficiency derivation in Appendix B.1.1 is also unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same claims about semantic preservation through chunk compression, layer-wise index reuse, and performance and efficiency advantages.

C2.justification: Interpretations and qualifications are unchanged, including Appendix C's acknowledged gaps in rigorously connecting sparsification to the error bound and Appendix I's fixed-size chunking versus latency limitation.

D1.justification: Implementation details in Appendix A.5, hardware and software settings, model and dataset statistics, prompt exemplars, and the code-release statement are unchanged.

R1.justification: Section 2, Appendix D, and the reference list are unchanged. No cited works or research-positioning arguments are added or removed.

P1.justification: v3 adds a corresponding-author dagger to Yue Liu and updates the arXiv stamp from v2 dated 21 May 2025 to v3 dated 27 June 2025. Scientific prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first page has small author-line spacing and arXiv-stamp placement adjustments. Figures, tables, captions, and the layouts of pages 2–41 remain visually identical.

improvement.justification: The revision changes first-page author annotation and stamp presentation while retaining the same methods, empirical evidence, theory, reproducibility information, and limitations. These administrative and cosmetic edits do not meaningfully change the paper's overall quality.
